Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target.
